description: Projects participations by organizations. One document is one project participation by an organization.

acronym.description: Container for the project's acronym in multiple languages.

default.description: Default or fallback acronym for the project when no language-specific version is available.

en.description: English version of the project's acronym.

fr.description: French version of the project's acronym.

address.description: Container for the organization's physical address details during the project participation.
Full street address of the organization's location during the project participation.

city.description: City of the organization's address during the project participation.

country.description: Country of the organization's address during the project participation.

gps.description: Container for the geographic coordinates (GPS) of the organization's address.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate of the organization's address location.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate of the organization's address in decimal degrees.

gps_id_name.description: Human-readable identifier for the GPS coordinates of the address.

postcode.description: Postal code of the organization's address, formatted per local standards.

region.description: Administrative region (e.g., state, province) of the organization's address.

ai_description.description: Container for AI-generated descriptions of the project participation in multiple languages.

description.description: Nested object holding language-specific AI-generated descriptions.

default.description: Default AI-generated description of the project participation, language-agnostic.

en.description: AI-generated description of the project participation in English.

fr.description: AI-generated description of the project participation in French.

alias.description: Alternative name or shorthand for the organization's participation in the project.

applicants.description: Nested object containing details about all organizations applying for the project participation.

name.description: Full name of an applying organization as provided in the application form.

autocompleted.description: System-generated completion status indicating if the participation record was auto-filled.

autocompletedText.description: Human-readable text describing the auto-completion status of the participation record.

co_partners_foreign_inst.description: Names of foreign academic or research institutions collaborating as co-partners in the project.

co_partners_fr_inst.description: Names of French academic or research institutions collaborating as co-partners in the project.

co_partners_fr_labs.description: Names of French laboratories collaborating as co-partners in the project.

co_partners_fr_labs_all.description: French lab names of all co-partners involved in the project participation.

description.description: Container for project description text in multiple languages or formats.

default.description: Default language version of the project description, used when no language-specific version exists.

en.description: English translation of the project description, if available.

fr.description: French-language narrative of the organization's role and contributions in the project.

domains.description: Hierarchical container for the scientific or technical fields the project addresses.

label.description: Localized display names for each domain, keyed by ISO 639-1 language code.

default.description: Fallback English label for the domain when no localized label exists.

firstName.description: First name of the primary contact person for the organization's participation.

fullName.description: Complete name of the primary contact person, combining first and last names.

institutions.description: Container for all academic or research bodies involved in the project.

label.description: Human-readable name of the institution as it should appear in reports.

inventors.description: Container for individuals credited with key innovations in the project.

name.description: Full name of an inventor as it appears on patents or publications.

isFrench.description: Indicates whether the organization's participation is linked to a French project or entity.

keywords.description: Container for keyword sets associated with the project participation in multiple languages.

default.description: Default language keywords describing the project participation when no language-specific version exists.

en.description: English-language keywords describing the project participation.

fr.description: French-language keywords describing the project participation.

label.description: Container for display labels of the project participation in multiple languages.

default.description: Default language label for the project participation when no language-specific version exists.

en.description: English-language display label for the project participation.

fr.description: French-language display label for the project participation.

lastName.description: Last name of the individual representing the organization in the project participation.

leaders.description: Container for key individuals leading the organization's participation in the project.

firstName.description: First name of a project leader associated with the participating organization.

lastName.description: Last name of a project leader associated with the participating organization.

nb_regions.description: Number of distinct geographic regions the organization operates in for this project participation.

participant_acronym.description: Container for acronyms of the participating organization in multiple languages.

default.description: Default acronym of the participating organization, used when language is unspecified.

en.description: English acronym of the participating organization.

fr.description: French acronym of the participating organization.

participant_encoded_key.description: Unique, URL-safe identifier for the participating organization.

participant_id.description: External identifier for the participating organization, references scanr-organizations index.

participant_id_name.description: Full name of the participating organization as referenced by its participant_id.

participant_id_name_default.description: Default display name of the participating organization in this project.

participant_ignore_funding.description: Flag indicating whether funding data for this participation should be excluded from calculations.

participant_ignore_funding_super_organiz.description: Flag indicating whether to exclude this participant's funding from super organization totals.

participant_ignore_total_budget.description: Flag indicating whether the participant's total budget should be excluded from aggregations.

participant_ignore_total_budget_super_or.description: Flag indicating whether to exclude this participant's budget from super organization totals.

participant_institutions.description: Nested object containing all institutions linked to the participant for this project.

endDate.description: Date when the institution’s involvement in the project ended.

label.description: Human-readable name of the institution associated with the participant.

natural_id.description: Unique persistent identifier for the institution within the system.

relationType.description: Type of relationship between the participant and the institution (e.g., 'parent', 'affiliate').

rnsr_key.description: RNSR key uniquely identifying the institution in the French research system.

startDate.description: Date when the institution’s involvement in the project began.

structure.description: Classification of the institution’s organizational type (e.g., 'university', 'lab').

participant_isFrench.description: Indicates whether the participating organization is based in France.

participant_is_main_parent.description: Indicates if the organization is the primary parent entity in this project participation (1 for true, 0 for false).

participant_is_part_of_super_organizatio.description: ID of the super organization this participant belongs to, if any.

participant_is_super_organization.description: ID indicating this participant is a super organization itself.

participant_key_id.description: Unique identifier for the organization's participation record in this project.

participant_label.description: Localized labels for the participating organization, keyed by language code.

default.description: Default name of the participating organization when no language-specific label is available.

en.description: English name of the participating organization.

fr.description: French name of the participating organization.

participant_main_category.description: High-level category classifying the participant's role or sector (e.g., 'academia', 'industry').

participant_region.description: Primary geographic region of the participating organization.

participant_region_with_labs.description: Participant's region including associated labs, if applicable.

participant_status.description: Current state of the organization's participation in the project (e.g., 'active', 'withdrawn').

participant_super_organization_children.description: Nested object containing child organizations of this super organization participant.

displayName.description: Display name of a child organization under this super organization participant.

id.description: Unique identifier for a child organization under this super organization participant.

participant_super_organization_id.description: Unique identifier for the super organization this participant belongs to.

participant_super_organization_key_id.description: Key identifier for the super organization's primary record, if applicable.

participant_super_organization_parent.description: ID of the parent super organization, if this participant is a child organization.

participant_type.description: Specific role or function of the participant in the project (e.g., 'lead', 'contributor').

participant_typologie_1.description: Primary classification type of the participating organization in the project.

participant_typologie_2.description: Secondary classification type of the participating organization in the project.

participants.description: Nested object containing details about the participating organization in the project.

funding.description: Amount of funding allocated to this participant for the project.

label.description: Localized labels for the participant's role or organization name.

default.description: Default label for the participant's role or organization name in English.

participation_funding.description: Total funding amount allocated to this project participation.

participation_id.description: Unique identifier for this organization's participation in the project.

participation_is_coordinator.description: Indicates if the participant is the project coordinator (true) or not (false).

participation_structure_accueil.description: Indicates if the participation involves hosting the project's physical structure (true) or not (false).

project_action.description: Primary action or activity type the organization performs in the project.

project_budgetFinanced.description: Amount of the project budget financed by the participating organization.

project_budgetTotal.description: Total declared budget of the project, including all funding sources.

project_classification.description: Automated classification of the project's thematic or scientific domain.

confidence.description: Model confidence score for the project's primary classification (e.g., 'high', 'medium').

justification.description: Explanation of why the project was classified under its primary field.

primary_field.description: Main thematic or scientific field assigned to the project.

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the project in the scanr-projects index.

project_instrument.description: Funding instrument or mechanism used for the project (e.g., 'grant', 'contract').

project_label.description: Human-readable name or identifier of the project, used for display and search.

project_pilier_global_name.description: Name of the global pillar under which the project is categorized or aligned.

project_type.description: Classification of the project (e.g., research, development, outreach) for categorization.

project_year.description: Year when the project was initiated or officially recognized in the system.

region_ignore_funding.description: Flag indicating whether funding data for the region should be excluded from calculations.

region_ignore_total_budget.description: Flag indicating whether the region's total budget should be excluded from aggregations.

startDate.description: Official start date of the organization's participation in the project.

title_abs_text.description: Abstract or summary of the project in plain text, optimized for full-text search.

web_content.description: Public-facing content about the project, such as web pages or press releases.
